mapper.insert: insert into meal_order(elder_id, catering_set_id, staff_id, deliver_time, dine_date, dine_type, pay_amount, status, dine_flag, create_by, remark, create_time) values (#{elderId}, #{cateringSetId}, #{staffId}, #{deliverTime}, #{dineDate}, #{dineType}, #{payAmount}, #{status}, #{dineFlag}, #{createBy}, #{remark}, #{createTime})
mapper.select: select mo.*, e.name as elder_name, cs.name as catering_set_name, s.name as staff_name from meal_order mo left join elder e on mo.elder_id = e.id left join catering_set cs on mo.catering_set_id = cs.id left join staff s on mo.staff_id = s.id where mo.id = #{id}
select count(*) from meal_order where dine_date = current_date
select count(*) from meal_order where dine_date = current_date and dine_flag = 1
